Crestwood Advisors Has Cut Its Holding in Union Pac Com (UNP) by $491,244 as Shares Rose; Biogen Idec (BIIB) Shareholder Swedbank Cut Position by $18.06 Million
June 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Swedbank decreased its stake in Biogen Idec Inc (BIIB) by 14.63% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Swedbank sold 66,164 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 386,129 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $105.73 million, down from 452,293 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Swedbank who had been investing in Biogen Idec Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $64.36B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.21% or $0.65 during the last trading session, reaching $305.03. About 1.47M shares traded. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) has risen 13.14% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.57% the S&P500.
